title: Sacroblade
summary: Sacredblade is an extremely powerful spell that creates a forceful wall of blue light that can reflect enemy attacks and send Titans to their Amulets.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This spell was used by [[Nimue Casterwill]] in conjunction with [[Soulburn]] during the war versus the [[Blood Spiral]] to defeat the army of [[Silent Soldiers]]. However, while doing so was able to help shift the tide of battle, such an endeavor resulted in Nimue losing her life. {{source|The Spiral War}}
